Mohit Joshi, CEO and Managing Director, Tech Mahindra, said,“Deal wins exceeding $1+ billion in each of the last four quarters reflect the strength of our customer relationships and the trust we have built. With 7.2% year-on-year constant currency growth, we continue to sustain business momentum. As we celebrate our 40th anniversary this quarter, we look ahead with confidence, building on our legacy of innovation, entrepreneurship, and long-term value creation for our stakeholders.”

Rohit Anand, Chief Financial Officer, Tech Mahindra, said,“We delivered another strong quarter of growth, with margins expanding for the twelfth consecutive quarter, reflecting disciplined execution. We continue to invest in AI to improve productivity, drive innovation and build capabilities for future growth. The Board has recommended an interim dividend of ₹15 per share reaffirming our commitment to shareholders.”

About Tech Mahindra

Tech Mahindra (NSE: TECHM, BSE: 532755) offers AI-powered technology consulting and digital solutions to global enterprises across industries, enabling transformative scale at unparalleled speed. With 146,000+ professionals across 90 countries, Tech Mahindra provides a full spectrum of services including consulting, information technology, enterprise applications, business process services, engineering services, network services, customer experience & design, AI & analytics, and cloud & infrastructure services. Tech Mahindra is part of the Mahindra Group, founded in 1945, one of the largest and most admired multinational federation of companies.

For more information on how TechM can partner with you to meet your Scale at Speed™ imperatives, please visit https://www.techmahindra.com/
